{{Quote|SALUDI's - FAVORITE OF PILOTS ACROSS THE GALAXY|The message displayed on a neon sign at the entrance to Saludi's|<ref name="CD" />}}
'''Saludi's''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that operated in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. A typical [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] bar, the cantina was popular with criminals, [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The cantina had a concealed back room used for [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]], from which a [[Coruscant Believers base|secret base]] used by the [[Believers]], a [[Sith cult|Sith-worshipping cult]] from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], could be reached. Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] ventured to the cantina while tracking the Believers and located the access point to the [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]]' hideout.

==Description==
{{Quote|I hear tell there's a network of tunnels what runs under this place, and that some unpleasant types still use them.|A spacer, on the tunnel network beneath Saludi's|<ref name="CD" />}}
Saludi's was a small [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The bar was built inside part of an old bunker situated in Coruscant's [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]], far from any natural light. The name of the cantina was derived from the term "Saludi", a word from a dialect of the [[Language/Legends|language]] [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] that translated into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] as "hidden". Outside, the cantina had a glowing [[Neon/Legends|neon]] sign that displayed the message "SALUDI's - FAVORITE OF [[Pilot/Legends|PILOTS]] ACROSS [[The galaxy/Legends|THE GALAXY]]" and flashed on a [[Color/Legends|color]] cycle from red to green, to blue to violet before repeating.<ref name="CD" />

A typical [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] bar, Saludi's was abuzz with a riot of sounds and fragrances, giving it a raucous but not unpleasant [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The cantina's interior was decorated with the same vibrant color scheme as the neon sign outside and a haze of thin smoke hung in the air. This was produced by the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|meat]] seasoning [[p'chab]], which could be purchased in the bar and gave Saludi's distinctive sharp smell, different to most other cantinas. Live [[Music/Legends|music]] from a [[Band/Legends|band]] resonated through the bar and raised stools were located throughout for patrons to sit on, intermixed by a number of hovering stools. [[Alcohol/Legends|Alcoholic]] beverages could be purchased on the premises.<ref name="CD" />

The cantina attracted individuals from across the breadth of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] including spacers, [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], criminal [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and other criminals. Its clientele included old, well-traveled spacers and young hotshot pilots, as well as [[Army/Legends|military]] pilots from worlds such as Coruscant and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and civilian-attired pilots from the planets [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The bar's denizens were wary of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]],<ref name="CD" /> an [[Jedi Order/Legends|order]] of [[Monk/Legends|monastic]] warriors allied with the Republic.<ref name="CSWE - Jedi Order">{{CSWECite|II|150|Jedi Order}}</ref> Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]],<ref name="Dates" /> the one-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Chez O'nder]] worked as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] at Saludi's and like to regale to the patrons of the bar with a tale of how he had fused his lips together by picking his [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]],<ref name="CD" /> a weapon commonly wielded by Jedi.<ref name="CSWE - Lightsaber">{{CSWECite|II|254|Lightsaber}}</ref> The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Colara]] worked as a bouncer at the bar and was ever diligent in her duties, always on the lookout for potential troublemakers.<ref name="CD" />

The bar had a concealed backroom used for [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]], which could accessed via the cantina's [[Refresher/Legends|restroom]] if one pressed a specific tile on the far-left wall that was 11 tiles across, 38 tiles down from the ceiling. Via a trapdoor beneath a table in the room was an access point to a network of tunnels that lay beneath Saludi's. The tunnels connected the bar to a nearby [[Coruscant Believers base|hidden base]] operated by the [[Believers]],<ref name="CD" /> a [[Sith cult|Sith-worshipping cult]] from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="BOTB">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|This place opened 50, maybe 60 years ago. Before that, I hear it was part of a bunker that goes back to one of the wars. Blast if I know which one, though. A spacer, on Saludi's|Coruscani Dawn|<ref name="CD" />}}
[[File:Coruscant-EotE.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Coruscant, the planet on which Saludi's was located]]
Saludi's opened between around [[91 BBY/Legends|91 BBY]] and [[81 BBY/Legends|81 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> located in part of a bunker that dated back to an earlier [[Time/Legends|time]] of war.<ref name="CD" /> By around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> the Human Chez O'nder had became a part-owner and bartender of the cantina and he hired out the hidden Saludi's backroom to a group of [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-using [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gambler/Legends|gamblers]]. Unknown to O'nder, the Twi'leks received a fee from the Believers every time one of the [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] passed through the room to reach the access point to their hideout. As a result of a surge in Believer activity, the gamblers earned a profit from renting the room.<ref name="CD" />

One evening, while O'nder and Colara were at work in the bar, a group of soldiers of the [[Mecetti House Guard]], a military force from the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], came to Saludi's to drink. Colara kept watch on the soldiers, looking for an excuse to throw them out.<ref name="CD" /> The playboy [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]]<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Xav Verivax]] also ventured to the cantina and attempted to chat up some Twi'lek [[Gender/Legends|females]]. Around the same time, a group of Believers passed through the bar while returning to their secret base with a [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]] box containing a fragment of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Conkesta]], which the cultists had stolen from a Coruscant [[Hangar/Legends|landing platform]].<ref name="CD" />

[[Standard minute/Legends|Minutes]] after the arrival of the Believers, a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] arrived at Saludi's in pursuit of the stolen box, just as Colara ejected a drunken [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] from the bar. The [[Agent/Legends|agents]] made enquires around the cantina as to where the Believers had gone and learned of the hidden back room. The freelancers then entered the concealed room, interrupting a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] being played by the Twi'lek gamblers, and made their way into the tunnels beneath Saludi's to confront the cultists.<ref name="CD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Saludi's was created by [[Morrie Mullins]] and featured in ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'', a [[2002]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure that formed part of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign. The adventure advises that the cantina should be depicted as having a similar atmosphere to the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]], a bar that appeared in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], but with a more [[Alien/Legends|alien]] ambience.<ref name="CD" />

In the adventure, the player characters roleplay as the freelance agents who come to Saludi's while tracking the Believers and their stolen Mandalorian iron box. The agents can interact with the inhabitants of the bar while searching for information on the cultists' movements and this can play out in various different ways. It is possible for the Jedi Knight [[Devan For'deschel]] to accompany the agents to the bar, in which case the cantina's denizens eye her and any Jedi player characters warily, though do not cause any trouble unless provoked. If the player wish to speak with the bartender Chez O'nder, he is initially unavailable due to being busy serving drinks but later becomes free and it is possible for him to provide the agents with details of the secret back room. The player characters can also bribe or otherwise persuade the spacers and soldiers drinking in the bar to provide them information on the concealed gambling room.<ref name="CD" />

An alternative eventuality is that the agents attempt to persuade the Wookiee bouncer Colara to provide them information, though she only speaks to them of the back room if a Wookiee among the player characters agrees to go on a date with her. It is also possible for the player characters to become involved in a confrontation with the [[House Mecetti]] soldiers relaxing in the cantina. This can erupt into a bar fight, in which case Colara intervenes to break up the brawl.<ref name="CD" />
